sources.title: fix(dialog): contain modal focus and restore the opener
sources.description: fix(dialog): contain modal focus and restore the opener
sources.prTitle: fix(dialog): contain modal focus and restore the opener
sources.prBody:
## Summary

React modal dialogs opened while focus remained on the trigger, allowing Tab to reach background controls and Escape to miss the dialog. Activate the shared focus utility when a modal opens and restore the opener on close or unmount. Preserve forwarded refs, child portal interactions, nested-modal ordering and consumer Escape cancellation. No public prop or style changes.

## Validation

- 119 shared focus/DOM tests and40 Dialog tests pass, with the actual Storybook built.
- Twelve actual FormDialog comparisons at375/768/1440 pixels in light/dark exercise keyboard Enter opening, initial input focus, both Tab boundaries, Escape and restored opener. Before, focus stays on the outside opener and Escape misses; after, Name receives focus and the modal contains keyboard navigation. All twelve have zero page errors. Browser-proof.json records the real assertions.
- Fresh full canonical make ci after actual merged Hierarchy main passes1116 tasks (1102cached). An inspected first local run stopped only because sandbox policy denied an unchanged real-socket relay fixture's127.0.0.1 listener; tests and implementation were not altered. The inspected local-socket rerun passed with tests unchanged. Forge gates remain required at the exact final head.
- Actual repaired main546 isf595b0757d1f889b9bb69f3a3bc7ce9e31bae8ee. The eight-file Dialog implementation is byte-identical to its previously tested prepared payload. Both rebase conflicts were generated stax design-graph metadata; both record sets were retained and original local documents preserved outside the commit.
- A React/Astro meta patch changeset is included. The current official compiler/pnpm lock is retained. Publication follows main Test Matrix, Changesets Version PR and trusted OIDC; this PR claims no release or production deployment.

## Visual evidence

Evidence-type: screenshots
Before-ref: 0332e5106d292d17c729dfc334afea5d0f937090
After-ref: 1e8fec2d481735f9eb4347acbb8bd90ed95edb65
Context: Real FormDialog Storybook, English, matching375/768/1440 viewports, light/dark, keyboard Enter from focused Edit Profile opener. Before captures use audit-repair547; the FormDialog story, existing Dialog implementation and shared focus source bytes are identical to the actual current merge base, confirmed by an empty scoped diff. After captures use the preserved Dialog payload, which remains byte-identical after rebase. Static screenshots show initial focus and browser-proof.json records navigation/restoration; the local harness follows system appearance.

- `packages/react-dialog/src/dialog.tsx`: Actual FormDialog comparisons exercise modal initial focus, both Tab boundaries, Escape close and restored opener in all three widths and both appearances.
- `packages/shared/src/focus-trap.ts`: Actual modal comparisons exercise the shared utility through the real adapter;119 shared and40 Dialog tests additionally cover hidden targets, empty/nested content and portaled controls.
- `docs-site/src/app/components/dialog/Dialog.stories.tsx`: The actual FormDialog story is used in every paired capture, with real keyboard focus observed from the iframe rather than simulated or injected.
- `docs-site/src/app/components/dialog/page.tsx`: The existing prop description documents the verified modal focus behavior; the corresponding actual story demonstrates the behavior without introducing a separate layout.

### Before

Caption: Keyboard opening leaves focus on the outside Edit Profile button; Escape misses the modal.
![Before modal focus at 375px in light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elloloop/refraction-ui/1e8fec2d481735f9eb4347acbb8bd90ed95edb65/docs/pr-evidence/dialog-focus/before-375-light.png)
![Before modal focus at 375px in dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elloloop/refraction-ui/1e8fec2d481735f9eb4347acbb8bd90ed95edb65/docs/pr-evidence/dialog-focus/before-375-dark.png)
![Before modal focus at 768px in light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elloloop/refraction-ui/1e8fec2d481

sources.title: fix(release): skip empty canaries and report publication failures
sources.description: fix(release): skip empty canaries and report publication failures
sources.prTitle: fix(release): skip empty canaries and report publication failures
sources.prBody:
Audit-only main releases currently reach Changesets3 snapshot versioning with no unreleased changesets and fail the canary step. The custom OIDC publisher also omits the `New tag:` marker consumed by Changesets Action and returns success after per-package publication failures.

Skip only empty public release plans. Keep pending canaries on the existing snapshot/OIDC path, create and report a release tag only after npm succeeds, and propagate publication/tag/registry failures. OIDC errors are sanitized so failed child processes cannot expose Authorization arguments. Credential files use exclusive creation, mode0600 and cleanup. The three existing public package names, provenance publishing and normal main Test Matrix → Changesets/OIDC release ownership are preserved.

Validation:15 process-mocked regression tests cover empty/private plans, snapshot failure, real command contracts, provenance, first-version E404, registry outage, existing versions, publish/tag failures, credential cleanup and redaction. The real official empty plan skips without versioning or publication. Full1108 canonical tasks pass (cached), audit has0high/critical (10moderate,1low remain), syntax and local visual-evidence policy pass. The regressions are added to the normal React Test Matrix. No local publication, workflow dispatch, credential/grant change or runtime UI change was performed.

The first CodeQL run identified excessive backtracking in the new version guard. The guard now has a256-character limit and non-overlapping prerelease/build groups; added tests prove long malformed input terminates before credential exchange and valid metadata remains supported. No security finding is waived. The initial stax-created quoted PR title was corrected; fresh source-head metadata checks are required.

sources.prBody:
This PR was opened by the [Changesets release](https://github.com/changesets/action) GitHub action. When you're ready to do a release, you can merge this and the packages will be published to npm automatically. If you're not ready to do a release yet, that's fine, whenever you add more changesets to main, this PR will be updated.


# Releases
## @refraction-ui/react@0.26.0

### Minor Changes

- 0332e51: Add HierarchyCanvas for scrollable top-down and left-to-right hierarchies with real DOM card slots, configurable geometry, decorative connectors and focus-preserving viewport updates. Export the deterministic hierarchyLayout core through the React meta package.

### Patch Changes

- 3f2927e: Activate focus containment and restoration for React modal dialogs. Skip hidden, disabled and negative-tabindex controls in the shared focus utility, focus empty panels, and keep nested Escape handling and consumer cancellation scoped to their dialog.
- f595b07: Cancel pending SearchBar debounced searches on unmount so callbacks and loading updates do not run after the component is removed.

sources.title: feat(media-frame): add a fixed-aspect frame for rendered media
sources.description: MediaFrame holds an image, a video or a live preview at a fixed aspect ratio on a letterbox surface, with an optional corner caption. The ratio takes a number, w:h or w/h and falls back to a square with a development warning; data-orientation exposes the shape; caption corners are logical; tone switches between the neutral surface and the tertiary accent. Headless core, React and Astro adapters, docs page, story and changeset.
